fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api passes, and TestPropertyProjectionParity passes with write views drawn from the projection only. A test shows a write in a change set that depends on an in-flight change set records the base version the strict what-if view gives, on a log where the interim rule would give another (one of the cases @{01M7GGYX1AJ24Y40XJK9GRY8P8} or @{01M7GGYX9DWE3H3TZ3G0TA4T8P} recorded, or a new one if they recorded none). Failure case: a write whose target the strict view has dropped (its parent's create gone) is refused with the not-found error, not written against a node the interim model kept. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(write|apply|add|set)' passes. Touches internal/api/write.go, write_indexed.go, read.go, ship.go, run_model_cache.go, repair.go and their tests. Must not delete newModel yet (the last leaf does) and must not change any --json shape.
fields.statement: Every write takes its model and the base versions it records from the projection under the strict rules, replacing write_indexed.go's hybrid (strict as-is rows with in-flight ops laid on as the interim model applies them), and the reads, ship, run-model-cache and repair paths that branch on IndexPath (write.go:189, read.go:180, :197 and :222, ship.go:359, run_model_cache.go:88, repair.go:161) take the projection path unconditionally
